title: Mall World Experiences
content: Hey guys, I’m new here and always have a reoccurring dream. I’m always at the same place but it’s always different scenery. I thought it meant something just for me, but apparently it’s a phenomenon people are experiencing. I honestly always look forward to going because it feels nostalgic. In the high school, I’m always on the second floor of the high school and there are so many stairs and the hallways go in a big square and I’m trying to find the bathroom. The doors are wooden and people in the classrooms look at me when I pass the doors that are open. The lighting is dim and it feels like I’m going to be late or can’t find my classroom. There are always a group of students helping me. I go down the stairs and there are so many stairs that go on forever. There’s a basement and it’s dark down there. There’s pipes on the ceiling and feels like I shouldn’t be there. There’s also trailer classes with wooden ramps. Outside of the high school is a random basketball court that is old and grass growing around it. There’s a big green field in the middle of the area between the high school and the elementary school. The parking lot in the high school is like a maze and I cannot get out. I always end up back at the starting point. The swimming pool at the school is indoors and sometimes it’s outdoors but now I realize the outdoor pool area is in the resort. I swam in a swimming competition in the indoor pool. I didn’t win and was embarrassed. There were so many people competing. The bathrooms in the high school/pool area are so gross and flooded. I got lost trying to find a toilet that would work. No toilet paper and lots of lockers. People seem very annoyed in the bathroom. I have been to the resort and the cruise ship, which are my favorite places to go in mall world. The islands are very clean with blue water. I love the jet ski and I’m always tan there. I have been on the train/sky lift and it was scary, but fun. It felt like I was in another country like Asia or something because I was going through trees. The airport is madness and the planes go really fast like a rocket but it’s super fancy. You have to have money to go on the airplane. The movie theater is always packed and I’m always with people I know. I have waited to get into the theater and it feels like the theater might be the spawning place because people are waiting and watching a movie, I can never make out what the movie is. There are highways that feel like it is going forever but you stay in the same area and don’t get anywhere. There are shops but I don’t know what they are . My scariest experience in mall world was when I went to the parking garage beside the airport and there were army officers there making sure who was coming in and who was going out. I got lost in the parking garage and couldn’t find my car. No one would help me and I ended up riding the roller coaster inside the parking garage. People had masks on and I was confused and scared. I honestly cannot believe others been to the same place. My question is how did this place get the name mall world?
